report: Reviewed the complete claim, sole implementation entry, complete sole annotated test, and captured review policy. Identity must precede and remain independent of signatures, members, fields, bodies and other lazy facts; item definitions use symbols, generic parameters/fields/locals use scoped identities, and downstream semantic values must reference those identities instead of deriving them from details. Every aspect remains explicitly deferred by the implementation TODO in sage_meta::todo (uniform isolation across item kinds and associated-item moves) and the test TODO crates_sage_ir_crate_identity_before_detail. The latter has no assertions or executable behavior: it calls for unchanged-definition identity retention under unrelated/detail-only edits and detail-query execution only for observed-input changes. Its prerequisite is complete identity/detail isolation plus associated, reviewed identity/edit evidence; that evidence must cover each identity family and downstream references as well as lazy detail queries. A hypothetical detail-derived identity change would not be detected by this empty placeholder, so this acceptance does not claim implemented behavior or adequate behavioral coverage. The existing TODO scope accounts for that gap without reclassifying it. No N/A or ordinary associated entries exist. Independently verified that both historical implementation_sources and test_sources for service_spec.rs are exact byte matches to current source; reassessed the supplied earlier rationale against current claim and TODO bodies rather than treating its approval as proof. Source inspection supports the same explicit deferral, with no additional edits needed. Executed review start, review read and byte-comparison commands, and submitted this report with review record. No tests/build were run by this reviewer; the coordinator's 321 passing tests and build are separately reported baseline execution and do not establish this deferred guarantee.
